title: Backstop Plan Schema v1
description: Schema for pure YAML implementation plans with agent-bounded tasks (D-080) and file exclusivity enforcement (D-081). Plans are machine-consumed — no markdown, no prose sections.

plan_id.description: Plan identifier derived from the spec or issue it implements

spec_id.description: The spec or issue this plan implements

status.description: Lifecycle status. Live: draft, ready, implementing, completed. Terminal/end-of-life: replaced (superseded by a named successor — requires replaced-by), canceled (work abandoned). No deprecated state for plans.

phases.description: Ordered execution phases containing agent-bounded tasks

enforcement.D-080: Every task must be agent-bounded: non-empty files, description, claims, and explicit depends_on
enforcement.D-081: Parallel-eligible tasks (no transitive dependency) must have disjoint file sets
enforcement.REQ-001: Every task must include a type field with a valid task_type_enum value
enforcement.REQ-002: TDD enforcement: implementation tasks must directly depend on at least one test task
enforcement.REQ-003: Gate cadence: phases with implementation or refactor tasks must include verification tasks
enforcement.REQ-004: Final phase must contain verification tasks covering all work categories (code and artifact)
enforcement.REQ-005: Refactor tasks may only depend on implementation, refactor, or test tasks
enforcement.REQ-006: Verification tasks must depend on at least one implementation or refactor task
enforcement.REQ-010: Test tasks may only depend on setup, test, or verification tasks
enforcement.REQ-011: Parallel-eligible phases must have disjoint file sets
